headline: Profit surges across the board while cash reserves shrink
summary_short: JPMorgan Chase reported Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $7.70, up 46.9% y/y from $5.24, as net income rose 41.2% y/y to $21.16B on revenue of $52.85B (+17.8% y/y).
summary_long: Diluted EPS of $7.70 rose 46.9% y/y (from $5.24) and 29.6% q/q (from $5.94). Net income of $21.16B rose 41.2% y/y and 28.3% q/q; pretax income of $27.52B rose 50.5% y/y. Revenue of $52.85B increased 17.8% y/y and 6.1% q/q. Total cash and equivalents fell to $309.81B, down 26.3% y/y and 0.7% q/q. Shareholders' equity rose to $374.60B (+5.0% y/y). Weighted diluted shares outstanding fell to 2,694.2M (-3.6% y/y). No margin ratios, drivers, or guidance are available from the shard KPI set alone.
